description: This Java class implements a command strategy for creating interest pause entries on loans by loan ID within the Apache Fineract platform. It processes batch requests, extracts path parameters, deserializes JSON request bodies, and interacts with the LoanInterestPauseApiResource to perform the creation operation.

classes.name: CreateLoanInterestPauseByLoanIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy component that handles creating interest pause entries for loans specified by loan ID, processing batch requests, and communicating with the LoanInterestPauseApiResource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to create a loan interest pause based on the batch request. Extracts the loan ID from the URL, deserializes the request body, calls the API resource to create the interest pause, and constructs the batch response.
